commonMistakes.title: Treating codice fiscale as identity proof
commonMistakes.text: The browser can inspect structure and control-character evidence, but it cannot prove that a person or identity exists.

commonMistakes.title: Confusing Partita IVA and codice fiscale
commonMistakes.text: Companies may expose VAT, fiscal code, REA, and PEC fields; store each normalized field separately.

commonMistakes.title: Assuming ABI/CAB means account ownership
commonMistakes.text: IBAN, ABI, and CAB slicing does not prove the account belongs to a person or company.

commonMistakes.title: Using dot decimals in Italian imports
commonMistakes.text: Italian CSV/accounting flows commonly expect comma decimals and semicolon separators.

highlights.title: Premium Italy suite
highlights.text: Sixty browser-only Italy workbenches cover tax, banking, e-invoicing, locale, privacy, vehicles, and developer-data workflows.

highlights.title: Field breakdown everywhere
highlights.text: Each tool exposes named Italian evidence slices for debugging instead of only generic result cards.

highlights.title: Official boundaries preserved
highlights.text: Registry, tax, bank, vehicle, carrier, SDI, and identity status checks remain outside browser-only validation.

developerNotes.title: Normalize for storage
developerNotes.text: Store compact identifiers such as IT VAT, codice fiscale, and IBAN separately from display punctuation.

developerNotes.title: Mask before logging
developerNotes.text: Codice fiscale, IBAN, phone, address, PEC, and document evidence should be masked in logs and screenshots.

developerNotes.title: Use official systems for status
developerNotes.text: ValidoHub provides offline shape evidence and handoff payloads, not regulated official decisions.
